timeout.recommendation: Add timeout configuration for storage operations, especially for S3/MinIO backends

retry.recommendation: Add retry with exponential backoff for transient storage failures

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Consider circuit breaker for storage backend to prevent cascading failures

bulkhead.recommendation: Isolate storage operations with connection pool limits

fallback.recommendation: Return 503 with retry-after header when storage is unavailable

idempotency.reason: Upload uses UUID-based paths, so retrying creates a new file; delete is idempotent

blast_radius.impact: Attachment uploads and deletions fail; existing attachments remain readable from DB metadata

findings.detail: Database-only endpoint, relies on DB connection pool timeouts
findings.recommendation: Ensure DB connection pool has appropriate timeouts configured

findings.detail: LoadAttributes loads excessive data; a slow DB could cause request timeouts for issues with many comments
findings.recommendation: Replace with targeted LoadAttachments call to reduce DB load

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Heavy issues with many comments could cause slow responses

findings.detail: Storage save and DB insert are in a transaction, but ChangeContent after upload is separate - if it fails, attachment exists but notification is lost
findings.recommendation: Make ChangeContent failure non-fatal or include in same transaction

findings.detail: No timeout on storage.Save operation for large files
findings.recommendation: Add context timeout for storage operations

non_atomic_operations: Storage save + DB insert (transactional) followed by separate ChangeContent call
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Storage unavailability blocks all attachment uploads

findings.detail: DB delete happens first, then storage delete. If storage delete fails, DB record is gone but file remains orphaned
findings.recommendation: Log orphaned files for cleanup; consider soft-delete pattern

non_atomic_operations: DB delete followed by storage delete - storage failure leaves orphaned file
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Storage failure during delete leaves orphaned files
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: DB record deleted successfully even if storage fails (partial success)

health_checks.recommendation: Add dedicated readiness check that verifies DB and storage connectivity

graceful_shutdown.detail: Gitea uses graceful.GetManager() for shutdown coordination

rate_limiting.detail: No per-endpoint rate limiting for attachment uploads
rate_limiting.recommendation: Add rate limiting for POST attachment endpoints to prevent abuse

dead_letter_queues.detail: No async message processing in these endpoints

cascading_failure_paths: Storage down → ep-259 upload fails → users cannot attach files to issues
Storage down → ep-261 delete partially fails → orphaned files accumulate
